name: Binary Search Tree
ground_truth: Every node has at most two children; left subtree values are strictly smaller, right subtree values are strictly greater.

analogies.analogy: Imagine a highway fork with clear speed limit signs: all vehicles going under 60 mph must take the left ramp, and all vehicles going over 60 mph must take the right ramp.
analogies.mapping_question: If a vehicle going 75 mph approaches, which ramp does it take according to this rule?
